content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more When it comes to rivalries, NOTHING in college softball hits quite like Oklahoma vs. Texas. Drama? ✅ Championship stakes? ✅ Walk-offs? ✅ Trash talk? ✅ We’ve seen it ALL. From national title beatdowns to walk-off thrillers in Norman, this rivalry has delivered legendary moments time and time again. 👇 Drop YOUR favorite OU-Texas moment in the comments! 👍 Like the video if you love beating the Longhorns 📲 Subscribe for more OU Softball content all season long 📌 Featured Games: 🏆 2022 WCWS Blowout Heard ‘Round the Nation 💣 Tiari Jennings sets the tone in 2024 🔥 Kinzie Hansen walk-off magic in Norman 👑 Jocelyn Alo's emotional finale 🥇 The 4-Peat is Secured in OKC Whether you’re a lifelong Sooner or just love elite-level softball, this video is for YOU. Let’s celebrate the dominance and the drama that is OU vs. Texas softball.
